gist: Ludhiana stockist: MR pushed Monte-LC on 10+2 (about 1,000 + 150) against normal sales of 500–600; holds 2–3 months and is told another scheme is coming; Amox-Clav orders cancelled by Gurugram, so he sells a rival brand.
test: **Confirmed.** STK0007 Sep: 1,000 invoiced + 148 free (primary_sales rows 92742, 93012). Amox-Clav unsupplied 16-Jul, 22-Sep, 30-Sep (rows 85559, 91669, 93564).

gist: Sales colleague: incentive pays only at 100% of primary, zero at 96%; push billing in the last 10 days; tells parties 'the company takes it back', and the loss is not in Sales' P&L. December target up 12%.
test: **Partly.** Last 10 days = 29.2% of Q1 FY27. Deccan had zero Amox-Clav and Monte-LC at 30-Sep. STK0140 bought ₹9.3 lakh in the last 7 days (he said about ₹8 lakh). Incentive terms are not in the pack: open question.

gist: Vaishali to Kavita: SKU-month MAPE steady at about 14%; allocation tab still on the FY25 split; FY26 review never closed; Sales overlay arrives as one number.
test: **Partly.** MAPE cannot be tested (no forecast file). Inferred Apr–Sep inflow: Lucknow 18.6% vs 20.7% of demand; Kolkata 15.2% vs 13.0%, so top-ups only partly closed the gap.

gist: Hooghly godown: since the new WMS, pickers take the front rack; old Cardio and Pain lots sit behind aisle 14; godown 95–96% full; batch logic only arrives in phase two (January).
test: **Confirmed, with differences.** 7 idle lots worth ₹11.8 lakh, at Kolkata only, 92% Cardio and Pain. Last shipped May–June (she said Feb–Mar); first reaches the 60-day block on 1 Mar 2027.

gist: Matrix Medicos: CLM-2607-02627 (₹68,004) uncredited, payment on hold; Hyderabad C&F told parties to resend claims; Area Manager approves no-invoice claims by phone.
test: **Confirmed.** Claim pending (expiry_claims row 4060). Hyderabad has the highest repeat rate (2.2% vs 1.1–1.9%); 55% of repeat claims carry no invoice reference vs 19.5% of all claims.

gist: Royal Pharma, Gorakhpur: Amox-Clav and Azithro not arriving for three weeks; a new 200-bed hospital order is short by six items; September anti-infective order went to a competitor.
test: **Partly.** Lucknow held zero of both at 30-Sep and 8 of this stockist's Sept lines went unsupplied, but **no Amox-Clav or Azithro order lines exist since June**. Hospital supply is outside this policy (§1).
